about.text1: Conception is a non-profit fundraiser created by a group of freshmen at Needham High School with one thing in common: A love of math.
about.text2: We want to share our love of learning to younger audiences by teaching more complex mathematical ideas to younger elementary students in creative and visual ways. That way, it is easy to understand AND fun to learn! By associating math with fun experiences, we can help educate and bring back interest in math at a time of decreasing interest (see home page for more info).

page_subs.contact: We'd love to hear from you!
